data.name: Carbonsate
data.description: Carbonsate is a Berlin-based carbon removal supplier founded in 2023 that develops terrestrial biomass storage projects in Namibia, Cameroon, Colombia, and Bulgaria. Its flagship Otjiwarongo project in Namibia harvests encroaching bush and stores it in sealed, oxygen-free underground pits, and in January 2026 issued its first 799 Puro.earth-certified credits as the 100th certified facility on the registry.
